scene: (function(){var pts=[];var N=40;for(var i=0;i<N;i++){pts.push({x:Math.random(),y:Math.random(),vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.0003,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.0003,r:Math.random()*2+1,ph:Math.random()*Math.PI*2})}function draw(){var w=W(),h=H();ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);var cx=w/2,cy=h/2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx-30,cy,140,-Math.PI/2,Math.PI/2,false);ctx.arc(cx-10,cy,140,Math.PI/2,-Math.PI/2,true);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=PALETTE[1]+"1a";ctx.fill();for(var i=0;i<N;i++){var p=pts[i];p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0||p.x>1)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>1)p.vy*=-1;var px=p.x*w,py=p.y*h;p.ph+=0.01;var alp=0.2+Math.abs(Math.sin(p.ph))*0.6;var alpHex=Math.floor(alp*255).toString(16).padStart(2,"0");ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=PALETTE[2]+alpHex;ctx.fill();for(var j=i+1;j<N;j++){var p2=pts[j];var dx=(p.x-p2.x)*w,dy=(p.y-p2.y)*h;var d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(d<130){var la=(1-d/130)*0.2;var laHex=Math.floor(la*255).toString(16).padStart(2,"0");ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px,py);ctx.lineTo(p2.x*w,p2.y*h);ctx.strokeStyle=PALETTE[1]+laHex;ctx.lineWidth=0.8;ctx.stroke()}}}requestAnimationFrame(draw)}draw()})()
